notes: CodingKeys (source line 636) permanently maps the Swift property `hasShownHandbook` to the wire key `has_shown_welcome_guide` -- the property was renamed for readability but the JSON key was never migrated, and never will be. This is the one concrete renamed-field case the decoder actually supports; it is not evidence of a generic decodeIfPresent-driven old-key migration. Case 2 pins that: a config that instead uses the field's own (made-up) snake_case name, `has_shown_handbook`, is NOT recognized by the decoder at all and falls back to the default (false), proving the decode only ever reads the one real wire key.
